messages.subject: Error pcount
parts:
Hi, 
I am running a pcount analysis with data from 15 sites and four sampling occasions. I am getting the error below in each of the three mixture models (P, NB, ZIP).
Does any one knows what this error means?

Heres is my code 

caiman.y <- caiman.data[,c("dia1", "dia2", "dia3", "dia4")]
caiman.umf <- unmarkedFramePCount(y=caiman.y)
pcount(formula = ~1 ~ 1, data = caiman.umf, mixture = "P")
pcount(formula = ~1 ~ 1, data = caiman.umf, mixture = "NB")
pcount(formula = ~1 ~ 1, data = caiman.umf, mixture = "ZIP")


Error in max(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 100 : 
  non-numeric argument to binary operator

Thanks in advance,

Adrian

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Error pcount
parts:
this appears to be some kind of data structure error in caiman.y
I suggest checking that these are numerical counts, that there are no all-missing rows, and that the object is a matrix, and then try it again.
